# Baseline profile for Novaura.
#
# Applied by androidx.profileinstaller on first run, which makes ART ahead-of-time compile
# these classes instead of interpreting and verifying them during cold start. That removes
# most of the class loading and verification cost between tapping the launcher icon and the
# home tabs appearing.
#
# Deliberately class-level only. Method-level rules ("H" for hot methods, "S" for startup) are
# intentionally absent: those have to come from a real profile generated by running the
# macrobenchmark on a device, and guessing at them by hand risks janking a method that turns
# out to be hot. The library rules below already cover the heavy AndroidX and Kotlin startup
# work, so the startup methods of these classes are AOT-compiled regardless.

# --- APP ENTRY POINTS ---
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/Auxio;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/MainActivity;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/AuxioService;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/MainFragment;

# --- HOME, REACHED IMMEDIATELY ON STARTUP ---
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/home/HomeFragment;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/home/HomeViewModel;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/home/HomeGenerator;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/home/tabs/TabAdapter;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/home/list/SongListFragment;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/home/list/AlbumListFragment;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/home/list/ArtistListFragment;

# --- REUSED VIEWS AND ADAPTERS ---
# Inflating these layouts is most of the frame budget of the first list draw.
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/list/recycler/ViewHolders$SongViewHolder;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/list/recycler/ViewHolders$AlbumViewHolder;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/list/recycler/ViewHolders$ArtistViewHolder;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/list/recycler/ViewHolders$GenreViewHolder;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/list/recycler/ViewHolders$PlaylistViewHolder;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/list/recycler/ViewHolders$BasicHeaderViewHolder;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/list/adapter/FlexibleListAdapter;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/list/recycler/AuxioRecyclerView;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/list/recycler/FastScrollRecyclerView;

# --- THEME AND IMAGE PIPELINE ---
# Resolving the accent and inflating covers both run before the first list frame.
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/ui/UISettings;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/ui/accent/Accent;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/image/ImageSettings;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/image/CoverProvider;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/image/CoverView;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/image/coil/CoilModule;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/image/coil/CoverFetcher;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/image/coil/CoverCompositionFetcher;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/image/coil/RoundedRectTransformation;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/image/coil/SquareCropTransformation;

# --- LIBRARY ACCESS ON THE STARTUP PATH ---
# The home tabs read the library to decide whether to show content or the empty state.
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/music/MusicRepository;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/music/MusicModule;
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/music/MusicViewModel;

# --- DEPENDENCY INJECTION ---
# Hilt generates component and injection classes that run on essentially every entry point, so
# they are always resolved during startup. Compiling them ahead of time is a large part of the
# win here, and they are entirely reflection-free generated code.
Ldagger/hilt/android/internal/aggregatedroot/codegen;
Ldagger/internal;
Ldagger/internal/asm;
Ldagger/internal/bytecode;
Ldagger/internal/codegen;
Ldagger/internal/doublecheck;
Ldagger/internal/lazy;
Ldagger/internal/loaders;
Ldagger/internal/Preconditions;
Ldagger/internal/Provider;
Ldagger/internal/WeakReference;

# --- SETTINGS, WRITTEN AND READ ON THE MAIN THREAD ---
Lorg/oxycblt/auxio/settings/Settings;

# --- VIEW INFLATION AND MATERIAL COMPONENTS ---
# AppCompatActivity and the Material theme carry a lot of class loading that happens before
# any of the app's own code runs.
Landroidx/appcompat/app/AppCompatActivity;
Landroidx/appcompat/app/AppCompatDelegate;
Landroidx/core/app/ComponentActivity;
Landroidx/fragment/app/FragmentActivity;
Landroidx/fragment/app/Fragment;
Landroidx/lifecycle/ViewModelProvider;
Landroidx/recyclerview/widget/RecyclerView;
Landroidx/viewpager2/widget/ViewPager2;
Lcom/google/android/material/tabs/TabLayout;
Lcom/google/android/material/appbar/AppBarLayout;
Lcom/google/android/material/bottomnavigation/BottomNavigationView;
Lcom/google/android/material/card/MaterialCardView;
Lcom/google/android/material/progressindicator/LinearProgressIndicator;
Lcom/google/android/material/internal/CoordinatorLayout;
Lkotlin/jvm/internal/Intrinsics;
